name: shoonaya-mcp
title: Shoonaya Spiritual Companion & Panchang MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server for Shoonaya providing astronomy-backed Panchang calculations, council-ratified multi-tradition festival calendars, Bhakti scripture library search, and Pathshala learning modules.

tools.name: getPanchang
tools.description: Calculate and return astronomy-backed Vedic Panchang (Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, Vara, Sunrise/Sunset, Rahu Kaal, Brahma Muhurta) for a specified date and location (defaults to traditional Ujjain meridian).

date.description: Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to current date)

latitude.description: Geographical latitude in decimal degrees (e.g. 23.1765 for Ujjain, 28.6139 for New Delhi)

longitude.description: Geographical longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. 75.7885 for Ujjain, 77.2090 for New Delhi)

tools.name: getFestivalDetails
tools.description: Retrieve council-reviewed festival or vrat details across Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist, and Jain traditions (e.g., Nirjala Ekadashi, Vaikunta Ekadashi, Diwali, Shivaratri, Gurpurab, Buddha Purnima, Mahavir Jayanti), including significance, parana window, fasting rules, and recommended observances.

festivalOrVrat.description: Name or canonical identifier of the festival or vrat (e.g., 'ekadashi', 'nirjala-ekadashi', 'diwali', 'shivaratri', 'gurpurab', 'uposatha', 'mahavir-jayanti')

tools.name: searchScripture
tools.description: Search the Shoonaya Bhakti Scripture Library for hymns, stotrams (e.g., Vishnu Sahasranama, Hanuman Chalisa, Shiva Tandava Stotram), and kathas with transliteration and translation.

query.description: Title, deity, or keyword of the scripture or hymn

tools.name: getPathshalaLessons
tools.description: Browse structured Pathshala learning modules across primary sacred texts: Bhagavad Gita, Guru Granth Sahib, Dhammapada, Jain Agamas, and Ramayana.

tools.name: askDharmaGuidance
tools.description: Query Shoonaya Dharma Mitra canonical guidance principles, tradition-neutral etiquette, and sadhana best practices.

topic.description: Spiritual topic, ritual inquiry, or practice dilemma
